game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Well, a frozen village well: the hold guard must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Keyword Switchboard: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Well: a frozen village well
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Well, repeat each round: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the wires value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the wall banner using at most 12 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 12.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 12 before the wall banner is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Keyword Switchboard
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Keyword Switchboard' (Week 6 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Frozen Well'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wires changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Frozen Well.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 12.
